Therefore, if $p$ is the largest prime satisfying $p<n$, then $n+a_{n} \geq 2 p$. We now claim that $a_{n}=2 p-n$ works for all $n>11$. To finish, we claim that $2 q \geq n$, which would be implied by $2\left(a_{n}+2\right) \geq n \Longleftrightarrow p \geq 3 n / 4-1$. This is indeed true for all $11<n<100$.
